lines: {player}! You came back! I waited right here by the portal. It's the glowiest spot, so I knew you'd find me.
I want to make moon-lamps for the boardwalk. So nobody's ever scared of the dark. Not even a tiny bit.
But they need something glowy inside. There are glow shells round the lake. Five of them!
YAY! Look along the shore. And by the dock. And on the boardwalk. Shells like to be near water.
Oh! And I saw a glowing blue schematic on the promenade, right by the portal. Take it to Dash and he can build something fizzy! And the Skate Park has letters hidden in it! So much to do!
Okay! The shells will wait. Shells are very patient.
There's a glowing blue schematic on the promenade by the portal, too. Dash can build something fizzy from it! And the Skate Park has letters hidden in it!
{player}! You came back! I waited right here by the portal. It's the glowiest spot, so I knew you'd find me.
There's a schematic glowing on the promenade tonight. Take it to Dash! And the Skate Park has letters hidden in it! S, K, A, T, E!
I'm going to go and say hi to my lamps. See you later!
Oh! Hi! I'm Pip. Are you a lamp? You're kind of glowy.
{player}: I'm {player}. Not a lamp.
Aw. Still nice, though.
{player}! Rex says he'll make more lamps when he's mayor. But I don't want to wait THAT long.
I want to make lamps NOW. Moon-lamps, for the boardwalk! But they need something glowy inside.
There are glow shells round the lake. Five of them! They only wash up when nobody's looking.
YAY! Look along the shore. And by the dock. And on the boardwalk. Shells like to be near water.
They glow brightest at night. Like me! Well. Like I wish I did.
Okay! The shells will wait. Shells are very patient.
Any glow shells yet? Look by the water! They're the shiny, glowy, roundy things.
(Pip bounces up and down.)
{player}: Pip! I found all five glow shells!
({player} opens {their} bag. Soft blue and pink light spills out.)
OHHH. They're even glowier than I imagined. And I imagined a LOT.
One for each lantern on the boardwalk. Hold still... there! And there! And there!
(One by one, the lanterns along the boardwalk light up like little moons.)
Now nobody has to be scared of the dark by the lake. Not even a tiny bit.
{player}: It's beautiful, Pip.
It's LAMPLIGHTER Pip now. I just decided.
Look at the boardwalk! The moon-lamps are still glowing.
I come and say goodnight to every single one.
{player}: Pip, Rex is running for mayor. What would you want a mayor to do?
MORE LAMPS! Big ones, small ones, lamps shaped like moons!
So nobody ever has to be scared of the dark. Not even a tiny bit.
{player}: That's a really good one, Pip.
Tell Rex I'll vote for him if he promises a lamp. A glowy one.
The portal is the biggest, glowiest light EVER.
I just want to look at it a tiny bit. Okay, a big bit. Okay, ALL the bits.
Can't stop! The lamps are coming on! See you on the boardwalk!
(yawn) The sky's getting light... home to my cave. Night night, {player}.
The market lamps are my favorite! They stand in a big circle, like a lamp party!
{player}: Do the lamps know they're at a party?
They do now!
(yawn) Too bright... come back when it's dark and sparkly...
Zzz... five more hours...
{player}: Pip? Pip!
{player}: ...He's asleep standing up.
It's getting dark! The lamps are coming on! Best part of the whole day!

rotate: Lamp! Lamp! Lamp! Did you see that lamp? It's SO round.
Want to go lamp watching with me?

lines: Yay! Lamp number one is... that one.
Lamp number two is... also that one. It's my favorite.
Okay! The lamps will wait. Lamps are very patient.

rotate: I counted all the lamps on the boardwalk. There are... a lot! I got too excited to finish.
